title: docs: correct bare noreply email auto-resolve claim in contributors README
claim: Only <id>+<login>@users.noreply.github.com auto-resolves in the attribution gate; a bare <login>@users.noreply.github.com needs a mapping file (audit --fix creates one).

evidence.doc_text_on_main: contributors/README.md:35-36 — "GitHub noreply emails (`<id>+<login>@users.noreply.github.com` and `<login>@users.noreply.github.com`) auto-resolve — no file needed."
evidence.source: .github/workflows/contributor-check.yml:51-52 skips only emails matching '\+.*@users\.noreply\.github\.com' ('GitHub id+login noreply emails auto-resolve'), then requires contributors/emails/<email> or a legacy AUTHOR_MAP entry; scripts/audit_pr_attribution.py:44 ID_NOREPLY_RE, :64-77 is_mapped() short-circuits only on ID_NOREPLY_RE; --fix (resolve_login + add_contributor.py) maps a bare noreply by WRITING a file.
evidence.red: Probe on main: is_mapped('123456+b2probe@users.noreply.github.com') -> True; is_mapped('b2probe-nonexistent@users.noreply.github.com') -> False; CI shell rule replayed: id+login -> skipped, bare -> MISSING. 225 bare-noreply files already exist under contributors/emails/.
evidence.green: README narrows auto-resolve to the id+login form and says the bare form needs a file (audit --fix creates it).
evidence.negative_control: Same probe distinguishes the two forms; reverting the README restores a claim the probe falsifies.
evidence.adjacent: is_mapped() probe + CI shell-rule replay (see red); no pytest target exists for contributors/README.md. docs-site-checks equivalent on the bundle branch: website/scripts/extract-skills.py + generate-skill-docs.py leave website/docs, website/sidebars.ts and website/i18n unchanged (clean); website/scripts/check_doc_links.py OK. added lines scanned for MDX hazards ({ } or raw <tag> outside inline code / fences): none. NOT_TESTED: Docusaurus build (website/node_modules not installed in this environment).
evidence.rebase: verified on main f848940560; bundle merges cleanly onto refreshed main eb8d21f482 (git merge-tree); merges cleanly with every B1 ready/docs-* branch that touches the same files

upstream_overlap: fork #80 / #116 / #125 change the same README claim: retire as duplicates of this lane (#116's explicit 'bare form does NOT auto-resolve' sentence is incorporated)
